notes: VAT 10% (Law on VAT as amended; rate restored to 10% by Presidential Ordinance 003 of 19 Mar 2024). The full art. 12 exemption list contains no investment-gold item - the only gold exemption is gold bars imported by/for the Bank of the Lao PDR for banknote printing. List read in Law 48/NA (2018) text on the Lao Trade Portal; a newer law (60/NA, 2024) gazette text was not openable. Duty null.

sources.name: Lao Trade Portal (Ministry of Industry and Commerce) - Law on Value Added Tax (Amended) No. 207/NA
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: the VAT rate is ten percent for imports and domestic supplies (0% only for exports)
sources.quote: Ten percent for the import of value-added goods, supplies, and services within the Lao PDR.

sources.name: Lao Trade Portal - Law on VAT (Amended) No. 48/NA, Article 12 (exempt activities)
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: the complete art. 12 list (items 1.1-1.19 and 2.1-2.21) contains no gold bullion or jewellery item; item 1.12 exempts only central-bank banknote-backing gold bars
sources.quote: ຄໍາແທ່ງ ເພື່ອຄ້ຳປະກັນການພີມທະນະບັດ, ການນຳເຂົ້າທະນະບັດ ແລະ ການນຳເຂົ້າເຈ້ຍ ຫຼື ໂລຫະ ເພື່ອພີມທະນະບັດ ໂດຍທະນາຄານ ແຫ່ງ ສປປ ລາວ
